validation.title: Check the form
validation.body: Some details are missing or invalid. Review the highlighted fields and try again.

unauthenticated.title: Please sign in again
unauthenticated.body: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue where you left off.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: Your role does not permit this action. Ask an administrator if you believe this is wrong.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: This record does not exist, or it is no longer available.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this
conflict.body: The record was updated by someone else. Refresh to see the current version before continuing.

possibleDuplicate.title: A record may already exist
possibleDuplicate.body: A patient with details like these is already registered. Compare the records below before deciding how to proceed.

unprocessable.title: Cannot process this
unprocessable.body: The request was understood but could not be completed as submitted.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.body: Wait a moment before trying again.

internal.title: Something went wrong
internal.body: The problem has been recorded. Try again, and tell your administrator if it continues.

unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: The system is not responding. Wait a moment and try again.

network.title: No connection
network.body: Your device could not reach the server. Check the network and try again. If this happened after you submitted something, check its status before resubmitting.

timeout.title: The request timed out
timeout.body: The server took too long to respond. The request may still have been processed — check before resubmitting.

intake.title: Request an emergency visit
intake.intro: Tell us what has happened and we will pass it to the clinical team. This form does not assess how serious your condition is.

facility.label: Which facility?
facility.hint: Choose the nearest one if you are not sure.

phone.label: Your phone number
phone.hint: So the clinical team can reach you. We will only use it about this request.

category.label: What best describes the situation?
category.notTriage: Pick the closest one. It does not assess how serious the situation is — it only tells the team what to expect.

peopleCount.label: How many people need help?
peopleCount.hint: The total number of people this request covers.

description.label: What has happened?
description.hint: In your own words. Include when it started and anything that has changed since.

intake.urgentNotice: This service is not for life-threatening emergencies. If someone is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now.

receipt.title: Request received
receipt.body: Keep this reference. You will need it if you contact the facility about this request.
receipt.trackingHint: Keep this token safe and private. It is how this request is verified as yours when you check on it or cancel it.
receipt.noAssessment: Your request has been passed on. It has not been assessed, and no one has been assigned to you yet.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.phoneFormat: Enter a phone number, including the area code.
errors.forSelf: Tell us if this request is for you.
errors.peopleCount: Enter how many people need help — at least 1.
errors.preferredContact: Choose how we should contact you.
errors.descriptionShort: Please add a little more detail.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests have been sent from this device. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your request was not sent. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.serverValidation: Some details were not accepted. Check the form and try again.
errors.facilityNotAccepting: This facility is not accepting requests right now. Choose another facility or contact it directly.
errors.generic: Your request was not sent. Try again in a moment.

intake.pageIntro: If someone needs urgent medical help, send a request and the clinical team will see it. You will get a reference to keep.

facilitiesUnavailable.title: This service is temporarily unavailable
facilitiesUnavailable.body: We cannot reach the list of facilities right now, so we cannot accept a request through this form. If this is an emergency, contact your nearest facility directly.

facilities.pageIntro: Search the published facility directory by name or location, and narrow it by what a facility offers. Results are public information only.
facilities.searchPlaceholder: e.g. Mombasa, or the name of a facility

facet.emergency24hHint: An emergency department staffed day and night

facilities.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {1 result} other {# results}}
facilities.emptyBody: Try a shorter name, or clear the filters and search again.
facilities.unavailableBody: The facility directory could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

track.pageIntro: Check what has happened since you sent an emergency request.
track.title: Track an emergency request
track.intro: Enter the tracking token from your receipt to see the current state of your request.
track.tokenHint: It is printed under the reference number on the receipt you received when you sent the request.
track.keepToken: Keep your token — you can use it to check again.
track.urgentNote: In an emergency, call your national emergency number now — do not wait for this page to load.

errors.required: Enter the full tracking token from your receipt.
errors.notFound: No request found for that token. Check that you copied the whole token, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.validation: Check that you copied the whole token, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Tracking is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: Your request could not be checked. Try again.

auth.signInIntro: Sign in to reach staffing screens. Your administrator gives you an organization ID.
auth.organizationIdHint: The organization under which this clinic is registered (your administrator gives you this ID).
auth.mfaChallengeBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this account.
auth.mfaRecoveryHint: A code you were given when two-factor was set up.
auth.mfaCodeError: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaCancel: Sign in with a different account

errors.unauthorized: The email, password or organization ID is incorrect.
errors.mfa: That code was not accepted. The code may be wrong, or the sign-in may have expired. Sign in again and try the latest code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.validation: Check the details and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again.

patients.pageIntro: Find a patient by name, patient number or phone, or register a walk-in.
patients.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No patients found} one {1 patient} other {# patients}}
patients.noResultsBody: Check the spelling, or register this person as a walk-in.
patients.emptyBody: Start typing a name, patient number or phone number. Results appear as you type.
patients.unavailableBody: The search could not be completed. Try again shortly.
patients.name: Name
patients.reasonForEntry: How this person came to be here

register.title: Register a walk-in
register.intro: Register a patient who has arrived without an appointment.
register.dobHint: Used to check for existing records.
register.duplicateIntroPL: A record matches the details you entered. Compare it before continuing.
register.duplicateIntroOther: {count} records match the details you entered. Compare them before continuing.
register.notDuplicateReason: Reason this is not the same person
register.notDuplicateReasonHint: For example: “Same name, visibly different patient.”
register.notDuplicateReasonRequired: Explain why this is not the same patient.
register.invalidDob: Enter a valid date of birth.
register.futureDob: A date of birth cannot be in the future.

queue.pageIntro: Take a ticket for a walk-in, call the next patient, and move tickets through the queue.
queue.staleMove: This ticket has already moved. The board has been refreshed.
queue.unavailableBody: The board could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

walkIn.title: Register a walk-in
walkIn.intro: Find the patient, choose a department, and take a ticket.
walkIn.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No patients found} one {1 patient} other {# patients}}
walkIn.noResults: No patient found. Check the spelling or register them first.
walkIn.selectPrompt: Select a patient from the results.
walkIn.noteHint: Anything the clinician should know before the patient is called.
walkIn.missingBody: Select a patient and a department before taking a ticket.
walkIn.alreadyActiveBody: This patient already has an open visit. Move or close that ticket first.
walkIn.ticketedBody: Ticket {ticket} has been added to the queue.
walkIn.ticketedBodyPosition: Ticket {ticket} is at position {position} in the queue.

appointments.pageIntro: Book, move and close out the day’s appointments, and work the department waitlist.
appointments.staleMove: This appointment has already moved. The desk has been refreshed.
appointments.actionFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again shortly.
appointments.unavailableBody: The day book could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

cancel.title: Cancel this appointment
cancel.intro: The appointment at {time} will be cancelled. The patient keeps their place in no list.
cancel.reasonHint: Recorded against your account with the time and the action taken.

reschedule.title: Reschedule this appointment
reschedule.intro: Pick a new slot for the appointment currently at {time}. The original is marked rescheduled and a replacement is booked.
reschedule.staleTitle: This appointment can no longer move
reschedule.staleBody: It changed since the list was loaded, or it is already finished. Reload and try again.
reschedule.failedTitle: The appointment could not be rescheduled

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.intro: Find the patient, choose a provider and a slot, and book.
booking.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No patients found} one {1 patient} other {# patients}}
booking.noResults: No patient found. Check the spelling or register them first.
booking.selectPrompt: Select a patient from the results.
booking.slotsPrompt: Choose a department, provider and day to see slots.
booking.slotsNone: No slots on this day. Try another day.
booking.appointmentTypeHint: For example: follow-up, new patient, review.
booking.missingBody: Select a patient, a provider and a slot before booking.
booking.conflictBody: The slot was booked while you were choosing. Pick another slot.
booking.failedTitle: The appointment could not be booked
booking.failedBody: The booking was not saved. Try again shortly.
booking.bookedBody: The appointment at {time} has been added to the day book.

waitlist.title: Department waitlist
waitlist.intro: Hold patients who could not get a slot, and fill offered slots.
waitlist.joinedBody: The patient now holds a place. They will show as waiting until a slot is offered.
waitlist.selectPrompt: Select a patient from the results.
waitlist.notesHint: Anything to know when offering a slot, such as preferred days.
waitlist.missingBody: Select a patient and a department before adding to the waitlist.
waitlist.duplicateBody: This patient already holds a place in this department.
waitlist.failedBody: The patient was not added to the waitlist. Try again shortly.
waitlist.empty: No one is on the waitlist for these filters.
waitlist.unavailableBody: The waitlist could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

vitals.pageIntro: Find a patient, record an observation, and review the append-only chart.
vitals.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No patients found} one {1 patient} other {# patients}}
vitals.noResultsBody: Check the spelling or register the patient first.
vitals.selectPrompt: Search for a patient to record or review their vitals.
vitals.rangeBody: One or more values are outside the range the record accepts.
vitals.missingBody: Enter at least one measurement or a note before saving.

record.title: Record vitals
record.intro: Vitals are append-only. A saved observation is never edited — correct it instead.
record.observedAtHint: Leave blank to record the current time.
record.savedBody: The observation was added to the chart.
record.failedBody: The observation was not saved. Try again shortly.

correct.title: Correct this observation
correct.intro: This writes a new record and marks the original as corrected. History is kept.
correct.reasonHint: Required. Recorded against the new entry.
correct.missingReasonBody: Give a reason before saving the correction.
correct.failedTitle: The correction could not be saved
correct.failedBody: The correction was not saved. Try again shortly.

history.title: Vitals history
history.caption: Vitals history, newest observation first
history.empty: No vitals recorded for this patient.
history.unavailableBody: The chart could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

schedules.pageIntro: Manage weekly provider hours and dated exceptions that override them.

templates.title: Weekly templates
templates.caption: Weekly schedule templates
templates.unavailableBody: The templates could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

templateForm.missingBody: Choose a provider and a department before saving.
templateForm.windowBody: The end time must be after the start time and long enough for one slot.
templateForm.failedTitle: The template could not be saved
templateForm.savedBody: The weekly window now feeds slot search.

delete.body: Slots from {provider} in {department} on day {day} stop being offered immediately.
delete.failedTitle: The template could not be deleted
delete.failedBody: The template was not deleted. Try again shortly.

overrideForm.title: Add a dated exception
overrideForm.intro: A leave, holiday, blocked day, or a one-off working window for a single date.
overrideForm.gapNote: The API has no endpoint to list exceptions, so this screen cannot show the ones already set for a provider and date. Adding a duplicate answers a conflict. Tracked as GAP-019.
overrideForm.missingBody: Choose a provider and a date before saving.
overrideForm.windowBody: For a working exception the end time must be after the start time.
overrideForm.conflictBody: That provider already has an exception on this date. Delete it first.
overrideForm.failedTitle: The exception could not be saved
overrideForm.createdBody: The date now follows this exception instead of the weekly template.

record.title: Patient record
record.emptyGuardians: No guardian recorded. Add one by editing the record.
